item.title: Douglas County seeks public input on Title 20 development updates to shape the future of land use in Carson Valley and Tahoe
item.description: Because Title 20 is the rulebook for how land can be used and what can be built in Douglas County, any updates will shape how future projects are reviewed and approved, including in the Tahoe Basin.
